item.title: Locations
item.description:
Class Location

ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡ ಶಾಲೆ currently meets in the local community classroom shared with enrolled families.

Use this page to publish:

  • Classroom address
  • Parking instructions
  • Drop-off and pick-up guidance
  • Accessibility notes
  • Weather or cancellation updates

Visiting Us

If you are visiting for the first time, please contact us before coming so we can confirm the current classroom, schedule, and visitor policy.

item.title: Teachers
item.description:
Our Teaching Team

ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡ ಶಾಲೆ is led by teachers and volunteers who care deeply about helping children build confidence, connection, and pride in Kannada.

Use this page to introduce:

  • Lead teachers
  • Classroom volunteers
  • Curriculum coordinators
  • Guest storytellers or cultural presenters

Teaching Approach

Our teachers use songs, stories, conversation, games, and structured practice. The goal is to make Kannada feel useful, joyful, and connected to family and community life.
